newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ job ads trend falls 0.1 pct in December - ANZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ job ads trend falls 0.1 pct in December - ANZ.

text.p: The trend number of New Zealand job advertisements in December fell 0.1 percent on the previous month, ANZ Bank said on Friday.
ANZ said the trend number of job ads continued to weaken in annual terms, down 8.8 percent from December 1995.
Job ads continued to decline in Auckland and Wellington during December, while they rose slightly in Christchurch.
In Auckland, the monthly job ads trend fell 0.1 percent in December following a 0.4 percent fall in November. The trend number was 7.1 percent lower than in December 1995.
In Wellington job ads fell 1.3 percent in December compared with a 1.4 percent decline in November and were down 19.1 percent on December 1995.
Christchurch recorded a 0.2 percent rise in job ads in December, but the trend number was still 10.1 percent lower than in December 1995.
